body:
selfhost/emit.prn now supports chained get-field (line.start.x-style), closing a gap named since get-field support first landed and hit as real friction while verifying struct-typed fields this same day. get-field-shaped?/emit-get-field widened into real, terminating mutual recursion, accepting either a bare-symbol target or a nested get-field-shaped? target. Scope stays honest: a non-get-field nested call as a target is still not attempted. 3 new tests including a real compile+run+assert check. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 6 selfhost domains + bazel build/test clean. PARENA commit e940abd.

⚓ ☃
title: Self-hosted compiler: nested/chained get-field support
